description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Approval of the Development Plan for the Biyagama Pradeshiya Sabha.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land development matters - specifically the approval of a Development Plan for the Biyagama Pradeshiya Sabha area under the Urban Development Authority Law. While it mentions a minister (Patali Champika Ranawaka), this is incidental to the main purpose of announcing land use planning and development regulations for a specific geographic area. The content focuses on land development authority and planning rather than government personnel changes or detailed ministerial portfolio descriptions.
